metadata.name: Virginia UAS test facilities with published specifications
metadata.description: Selected Virginia flight facilities with official public dimensions, infrastructure, or operating constraints.
metadata.disclaimer: Inclusion does not imply availability, access, scheduling approval, airworthiness approval, or authorization for a particular aircraft or operation.

properties.name: MARS UAS Airfield
properties.published_size: Direct access to 75 square nautical miles of restricted airspace
properties.launch_recovery: 3,000 ft by 75 ft runway and a vertical takeoff and landing pad
properties.support_infrastructure: 90 ft by 50 ft hangar and UAS integration and airfield management support
properties.aircraft_scope: Government and commercial unmanned-aircraft training, testing, demonstrations, and exercises
properties.flight_constraints: Secure federal facility; operations use the NASA Wallops range environment and require coordination through MARS.
properties.access: Coordinated customer access; not a public-use airfield

properties.name: NASA Langley UAS Test Range and CERTAIN
properties.site_type: Open-air research range and urban test environment
properties.published_size: 100-acre designated UAS test range; CERTAIN provides a city-like research environment
properties.launch_recovery: Official sources do not publish runway or launch-pad dimensions
properties.support_infrastructure: Live small-UAS flight range connected to NASA remote-operations and autonomy research
properties.flight_constraints: Flight time is scheduled through NASA's UAS Operations Office; the Air Force requires advance notification, NASA security is notified, and a NASA range safety officer must be present.
properties.access: Coordinated research access; not an open public flying site

properties.name: Virginia Tech Drone Park
properties.published_size: 3 million cubic feet in a 300 ft by 120 ft by 85 ft netted enclosure
properties.launch_recovery: Netted enclosure; the official facility page does not describe a runway
properties.support_infrastructure: Adjacent laboratory, classroom, work, and observation space
properties.aircraft_scope: Drone research, instruction, and controlled flight work
properties.flight_constraints: The enclosure is not considered part of the National Airspace System. Orientation and scheduling are required; commercial and third-party operations have additional requirements.
